fusions.name: Longshot
fusions.desc: A thrown blow that deals 7 damage, harder the further it travels, up to 2 times its damage at maximum range. It holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Scatter Blast
fusions.desc: Looses a wide cone ahead that deals 14 damage to everything in it and knocks it back 3 tiles. You heal for 15% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Quick Draw
fusions.desc: Increases your critical hit chance by 25% for 10 seconds, and you heal 8 health.

fusions.name: Follow-Through
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, your physical damage rises by 30% for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
